sampling.selection: The first distinct title from each of four published 2026-11-17 rankings, plus the previously verified title 掌上珠.
sampling.danmaku: One page, requested page size 10, from each selected series first episode.
sampling.comments: One public detail-page preview and one public first-episode preview per selected series.

metric_qualifications.play_count: Series-level count returned by the app SDK.
metric_qualifications.follow_count: Retained under its original SDK field name. This pilot does not establish equivalence with the requested subscription count.
metric_qualifications.web_favorite_counts: Favorite counts returned by each web page. Detail-page values can be rounded. Values and collection times can differ from the SDK.
metric_qualifications.click_count: No independent source field has been verified. Cells remain empty.
metric_qualifications.subscription_count: No teacher/platform definition has been confirmed. Cells remain empty.
metric_qualifications.comment_counts: App episode comment counts, web episode comment totals, and series review totals are retained separately. They can differ.
metric_qualifications.danmaku: The server provides a selected subset. Platform total and observed sample count are retained separately.
